author: New China TV
description:
In June 2000, a new CT scanner was donated to China's Huangyuan County. David Victor Plymire, an American raised in China, bowed to it and said in the local dialect: "This machine must serve the people of my hometown well."
Over 30 years, he crossed the Pacific more than 20 times, donating over 30 pieces of medical equipment worth more than 6 million yuan to the hospital. Though he can no longer travel, he keeps in touch with old Chinese friends.
title: A 95-year-old American, speaking a Qinghai dialect: "I will never forget you."

description:
Ninety years ago, 31-year-old American journalist Edgar Snow broke through blockades and ventured deep into China's impoverished northwest to interview the Red Army, producing the world-shaking work "Red Star Over China."
This summer, Chinese and foreign participants, including representatives of the Edgar Snow Memorial Foundation, followed in Edgar Snow's footsteps and went on a journey through China's revolutionary past and present.
title: Retracing the footsteps of Edgar Snow (Part II)
